start.text: New face! PG hunting, ah? Careful with that green-gate fellow. He says 'full' to everybody and takes token. There is no room — his brother-in-law's family stays there.

tip.text: Shanthamma, the blue gate, number ten. Strict — veg only, gate locks at ten — but honest. Talk nicely, she'll come down a little.

bye.text: Eat something. You look like you came straight from the airport.

scammed.text: You paid him?! Aiyo. How much? … He's gone to his native, phone switched off. Every month, same drama.

lesson.text: Never pay token without seeing the room. Go to Shanthamma, the blue gate. She takes full deposit — but she gives you a real room.

after.text: Blue gate, number ten. Go, go, before somebody else takes the cot.
